name: Cruinn
text: Cruinn is a variant spelling of Crunniuc, the Ulster farmer of saga. The goddess Macha chose that mortal man and shared his farm. His boast against his pregnant wife brought a horse race she ran and lost at the finish. Her dying curse laid the Debility of the Ulstermen on the province. Readers should follow the Crunniuc entry for the tale.

attributes.attribute: name form of the husband whose boast brought Macha's curse

okr.objective: Records Cruinn as a spelling variant of Crunniuc and points readers to his tale.
key_results: Opens with the variant relation to Crunniuc.
